method.correlation: Spearman rank correlation; primary ranking by absolute account-adjusted rho, with pooled rho shown for comparison
method.action_rate_definition: 100 * action count / recorded views, matched by capture
method.duration_rate_definition: 100 * average watch seconds / video duration seconds
method.account_adjustment: Partial Spearman: remove account-specific means from the global ranks before correlation
method.bootstrap: 3000 resamples within account, seed 1729; descriptive 95% interval
limits: One latest matched capture per reel per metric; metric coverage and capture dates vary.
20 saved reels across 4 accounts; descriptive associations are not causal effects or validated predictions.
Percentages containing views in the denominator can have mathematical coupling with views.
Counts may be rounded; retention curves are estimates.
Loops are excluded from the percentage-only ranking because views per viewer is a ratio rather than a percentage outcome.
